mapper.select: SELECT CAST(config_value AS UNSIGNED) FROM t_system_config WHERE config_key='alert.governance.expected-rule-count' AND is_active=1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ruleCode')) rule_code,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ruleName')) rule_name,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.category')) category,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.defaultSeverity')) default_severity,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ownerTeam')) owner_team,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.evaluationMode')) evaluation_mode,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.implementationStatus')) implementation_status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.governanceStatus')) governance_status,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.parameterTemplate') parameter_template,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.recoveryPolicy')) recovery_policy,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.dataDependencies') data_dependencies,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.p0NonSilenceable')) AS UNSIGNED) p0_non_silenceable,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.sourceReference')) source_reference,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.preventionClass')) prevention_class,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.preventionMeasures') prevention_measures,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.automatedGates') automated_gates FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ALERT_RULE_CATALOG' AND is_active=1 ORDER BY category,default_severity,rule_code
